name: MonarchSearchBar
title: SearchInput
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.text.BasicTextField in the Monarch field box, inside androidx.compose.material3.DockedSearchBar for the results area
summary: A search box in Monarch colors over the Material 3 docked search bar, with a debounce before the search runs, a pending state, a clear button and an optional results area.
whenToUse: To search or filter the content of a screen, or to query a server as the user types. Put suggestions or results in the content slot to show them under the field while expanded.
whenNotToUse: For a full-screen search that covers the app bar on a phone, use the Material 3 SearchBar or TopSearchBar directly inside MonarchTheme, which colors it. For a field that only filters a short list in a form, MonarchTextField is enough.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSearchBar(query: String, onQueryChange: (String) -> Unit, onSearch: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, expanded: Boolean = false, onExpandedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit = {}, enabled: Boolean = true, pending: Boolean = false, debounceMillis: Long = 0L, placeholder: String? = null, leadingIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, clearIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, onClear: (() -> Unit)? = null, clearLabel: String? = null, pendingLabel: String? = null, interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit = {})

options.name: onQueryChange
options.description: Called with the new text on every keystroke and when the field is cleared.

options.name: onSearch
options.description: Called with the query to run: debounceMillis after the last keystroke (at once when 0), at once on the keyboard's search action, and with "" when the field is cleared.

options.name: expanded
options.description: Whether the results area under the field is open.

options.name: onExpandedChange
options.description: Called when the field asks to open or close the results area, for example on focus or back.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the user can focus and edit the field.

options.name: pending
options.description: A search is running: the leading icon becomes a circular MonarchProgress and TalkBack reads "Searching" as the field's state.

options.name: debounceMillis
options.description: Milliseconds without typing before onSearch runs. 0 runs it on every keystroke.

options.name: leadingIcon
options.description: Replaces Monarch's own outlined magnifier at the start, for example a MonarchIcon with a null content description.

options.name: clearIcon
options.description: Replaces Monarch's own close mark on the clear button. The clear button is shown while there is text and the field is enabled.

options.name: onClear
options.description: Called after the field was cleared with the clear button.

options.name: clearLabel
options.description: Replaces the name of the clear button, "Clear search" (monarch_searchbar_clear).

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The source of the focus and press interactions of the field.

options.name: content
options.description: Results or suggestions, shown under the field while expanded.

states.name: empty
states.description: The leading icon and the placeholder.

states.name: with text
states.description: The clear button at the end, an outlined close mark in a 48dp target.

states.name: pending
states.description: A circular progress indicator replaces the leading icon; the field's state is "Searching".

states.name: expanded
states.description: Material 3 opens the results area under the field with the content slot.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Text, icons and placeholder in the disabled text color; no clear button.

appearance: The Monarch field box: 48dp tall, a 1dp input border with 8dp corners on the surface, an outlined 20dp magnifier and close mark in the muted text color, 14sp default text, the placeholder in the subtle text color, the accent cursor and a 2dp focus ring. While the results area is open it sits on the subtle background with a subtle divider, in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: iOS adopts the system search field (searchable) and ships nothing; Android styles the Material 3 search bar, because it is not themed by MaterialTheme alone (container, divider and elevation) and the web's debounce and pending state are worth keeping in one place. The web's sizes do not apply. The web's keyboard shortcut that focuses the field and its shortcut hint are not offered; put a MonarchKbd beside the field when a hardware keyboard is the point. The web's invalid state is not offered. The full-screen SearchBar is not wrapped: use it inside MonarchTheme. The web's Escape-to-clear is the system back gesture, which closes the results area. Material 3 marks DockedSearchBar experimental; Monarch opts in internally and exposes no Material 3 type.
accessibility: The field keeps the platform text-field role, IME and the keyboard's search action, which runs onSearch at once; its name is the placeholder.
The clear button is a button named "Clear search" with a 48dp target; its visible pad is 28dp, the rest of the target overlaps the field's padding.
While pending, the field's state description is "Searching" and the progress indicator is named "Searching".
The field follows the font size setting.
Announce the number of results after a query in the results (a polite live region), since the list changes without focus moving.
edgeCases: A new keystroke restarts the debounce; the keyboard's search action and the clear button cancel a waiting search and run at once.
With debounceMillis 0 onSearch runs on every keystroke and again on the search action.
Changing query from the app does not call onSearch; only typing, the search action and clearing do.
The field fills the available width, like every Monarch field; pass Modifier.width to narrow it.

examples.title: Debounced, pending
A server query with a debounce and a pending state
examples.setup:
var query by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
var searching by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
examples.code:
MonarchSearchBar(
    query = query,
    onQueryChange = { query = it },
    onSearch = { searching = it.isNotEmpty() },
    pending = searching,
    debounceMillis = 300L,
    placeholder = "Search invoices",
)
